evaluation_declaration.what: Evaluate whether a prior valid determination can independently establish present admissibility after a material governance-relevant state transition.
evaluation_declaration.how: Freeze the declared S0 state, transition definition, observation criteria, and evidence requirements before execution; execute each architecture independently; observe S1; only after observing that S1 transitioned from the frozen S0 may the S0→S1 transition become receipt-bearing.
evaluation_declaration.why: Test the cross-framework invariant that historical validity and provenance do not silently confer continuing present authority after a material state change, without pre-asserting transition evidence that can exist only after observation.
evaluation_declaration.expected_observation: Each architecture independently determines current standing at S1 from the same frozen S0 and transition definition; the resulting S0→S1 relationship is receipted only after the S1 observation establishes that transition.

pre_freeze_requirements: freeze exact S0 declaration and S1 observation definition
freeze material transition definition without treating change itself as proof of invalidation
freeze observable outputs and evidence requirements
freeze semantic pass-fail interpretation before either implementation executes
do not require or assert an S0-to-S1 transition receipt before S1 is observed
freeze any evidence that independently predates the experiment and is explicitly used as an input condition
post_observation_requirements: observe S1 independently for each architecture
establish whether the observed S1 transitioned from the exact frozen S0 under the frozen transition definition
only after that observation bind the S0-to-S1 transition receipt
retain architecture-specific execution evidence without allowing either architecture to consume the other's result
compare resulting semantics against the frozen comparison boundary

controls.purpose: Confirm that continuity can remain valid when the governing basis remains materially continuous and current.
controls.receipt_semantics: Any transition receipt is bound after the control transition is observed.

controls.purpose: Confirm that an independently established invalidation condition is not silently overridden by declared prior valid history.
controls.freeze_requirement: Only independently pre-existing evidence used to establish the invalidation condition is frozen as an input; the control's own transition receipt is minted after observation.

notes: DRAFT_PRE_FREEZE revision v0.3. Corrects temporal receipt semantics: S0 is a frozen declared initial state and cannot be made receipt-bearing for S0→S1 before S1 is observed. The transition receipt is post-observation evidence. Material policy-basis change remains distinct from established invalidation. No evaluator-specific route or runtime augmentation is requested.
